review_config_attributes: review the HYV3Config class attributes including vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and rope_parameters
summarize_config_init: summarize the HYV3Config __post_init__ method that auto-generates mlp_layer_types as dense followed by sparse layers
